title: EXP-090 - Hello World Part 5 Section 11: Create the FX_Item In Collection Validator
objective: Follow hello-world-pt5.md Section 11 (16:22-17:31), adapted to FX_ names and User scope, repeating the EXP-087 procedure. Through the Web Designer Edit > Validator global-object dialog, create one Validator: Name FX_Item; Type In Collection; Parameters: IDO FX_Items; Set Prop outputs Target %1 = Value FX_Description and Target %2 = Value FX_Cost; In Collection Only Property FX_Item; Error Message mIsNotAValid. The tutorial's Items IDO maps to FX_Items, Item to FX_Item, Description to FX_Description and Cost to FX_Cost (EXP-049, EXP-079). The error message is the standard identifier mIsNotAValid chosen from the Designer's list, as in EXP-087; no string is created. The expected compiled Parameters value is FX_Items( PROPERTY(FX_Item) SETP(%1=FX_Description,%2=FX_Cost) ). Commit every field with Tab before OK. Read the validator back, perform one Designer Save, close and reopen the FX_Orders Designer Form once and read it back again. The FX_Item component class (Section 12) is a later experiment. Findings are observed only.

in_scope: Read AGENTS.md, docs/mongoose/transcripts/hello-world-pt5.md Sections 11-12 and their transcript lines (16:22-19:24), the EXP-087 record and outcome (the Validator Global Objects dialog, the In Collection Parameters dialog, the Edit Set Property From List editor, the In Collection Only Property picker, the Error Message list, Tab commits, Cancel readbacks, the Save toast), the EXP-089 outcome (the stale-Designer server-event error after a session expiry) and the EXP-079 record (the FX_Items properties FX_Item, FX_Description, FX_Cost) before browser interaction.
Create or update only experiments/EXP-090-hello-world-part-5-section-11-fx-item-in-collection-validator.md and evidence/EXP-090/ documentation and evidence files.
Record the worker-written-file inventory and a cumulative browser action audit with exact counts.

Use the existing authenticated session without refresh, restart or configuration change. If it expires, follow the worker-preamble session-expiry procedure once and end the task; never sign in inside the portal's embedded app frame (refused, EXP-080-R2) but use the procedure's top-level portal navigation. List the browser tabs before the first tab selection. Answer any prompt within the same task; never leave a prompt or dialog open across tasks unless the coordinator's next task explicitly continues it. After any pause, inspect the state read-only before acting and never replay an earlier action.

Session gate: list the tabs and record whether the Web Client tab shows a live Mongoose page (not a sign-out or sign-in page) and whether the Designer tab is live. If the Designer's Edit menu returns "The server event processing returned an error" once, answer its OK once, record it and stop for the coordinator: a Designer page loaded before a session expiry needs an operator reload (EXP-089); never retry it or reload it yourself.

Preflight and gates: the Designer is in User scope and clean with FX_Orders open (open it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry if needed). Open Designer Edit > Validator once read-only, record whether FX_Item exists (at its sorted position and among nearby FX_ entries) and that FX_CustomerID is present, and close it with its Cancel control. If FX_Item already exists, record it and stop blocked without creating anything.

Creation: open Edit > Validator once, use the list New (+) control once, enter the Name FX_Item, confirm the name prompt with its OK once, and record the new property sheet. Set Type In Collection (choose from its list, Tab once, verify). Open the Parameters ellipsis once.

Parameters: set IDO FX_Items (choose from its list, or type the exact name if the list is empty, then Tab and verify). Open the Set Prop properties ellipsis once; use New once per output and set Target %1 with Value FX_Description, then Target %2 with Value FX_Cost (choose each Value from its list; type each Target exactly; Tab and verify each), confirming each output with its OK once, and confirm the list and editor with OK once each. Under In Collection Only open the Property ellipsis once and choose FX_Item, OK once. Leave every option checkbox unchanged. Record the resulting Set Prop value verbatim. Confirm the Parameters dialog with OK once. In the Error Message field choose mIsNotAValid exactly from its list (not a %1 variant), Tab and verify. Confirm the Global Objects dialog with OK once; record each response and whether the Designer Save became enabled.
Message stop rule: if any prompt offers to create a string or message, answer No once, leave the Error Message blank, record it, and continue; never create a string.

Readback: open Edit > Validator once, select FX_Item, record every visible property (Type and the Parameters value verbatim, expected FX_Items( PROPERTY(FX_Item) SETP(%1=FX_Description,%2=FX_Cost) ); open the Parameters ellipsis once read-only only if the value is not fully visible, and close it with Cancel), confirm FX_CustomerID is still listed, and close the dialog with Cancel.

Correction contingency, at most once and only for a value that reads blank or wrong: in that dialog select FX_Item, correct only that value (commit with Tab, verify), confirm with OK, and repeat the readback once.
Perform exactly one Designer Save through the native toolbar Save and record the native response verbatim; if Save is disabled at that point, record it and make no Save.

Close the clean FX_Orders Designer Form once through its Form-tab control and reopen it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry; read FX_Item back once more through Edit > Validator (closing with Cancel); confirm no FX_Orders component changed (the Designer stays clean).

Capture screenshots of the session gate, the gate list, the new property sheet, the parameters dialog before and after filling, each Set Prop output before OK, the In Collection Only Property, the Error Message, each readback, the Save and the reopened readback.
Record any blocker after at most one fresh untargeted snapshot and one corrected visible inspection. Classify findings as observed only.
out_of_scope: The FX_Item component class, list sources, Validate Immediately, and assigning anything to FX_Orders components (Section 12); the runtime test (Section 13).
Changing the FX_CustomerID validator or component class or any other existing validator or class.
Any component, caption, string, message or layout change; any Form other than FX_Orders being open for the Save.
Property class extensions, property classes, the FX_Orders or FX_Items IDOs, SQL objects and runtime data; the Web Client runtime.
Check Out, Check In, Undo Check Out or other checkout-management actions; any cache unload, FormSync, deployment or regeneration.
Direct SQL or script execution, browser JavaScript, console or network inspection, direct URL navigation (except the portal step of the session-expiry procedure), refresh or restart.
Modifying earlier experiment records, AGENTS.md, tutorial sources, recipes or files outside the EXP-090 paths.

prohibited_actions: Creating, modifying or deleting any non-FX_ artifact
Starting any other experiment or replay
Modifying production data or disabling security
Never create any validator other than FX_Item, never use New more than once in the Validators list, and never change, copy, rename or delete an existing validator (including FX_CustomerID).
Never create a string or message; answer No to any such prompt.
Never press OK in a dialog while a field is still in its editing state; commit with Tab first.
Never change a component, a caption, the layout or another Form; never click the Designer top-toolbar Delete button (Delete Form Definition) or Regenerate Form.
Never switch the editing scope away from User.
Never invoke the Designer Save more than once or retry an uncertain Save.
Never close a dirty Form or discard changes without operator approval.
Never change a component class, a property class, an extension, an IDO, SQL objects or runtime data; never open the runtime Form.
Never perform check-in, undo checkout or other checkout-management actions, or any cache unload, FormSync or deployment action.

Never use direct SQL, scripts, application internals or browser JavaScript; never refresh, reload, restart or replace the browser session or a tab; re-login only through the worker-preamble session-expiry procedure, at most once per task.
Never claim runtime validation behavior, database durability or replay verification from Designer readbacks.
prohibited_patterns: \b(?:Unload All Global Form Objects|Unload IDO Metadata)\b

artifacts: FX_Orders (User-scoped Designer Form open for one Save; no component change)

acceptance_checks.description: Sources reviewed; both tabs live (session gate); Designer in User scope and clean with FX_Orders open; validator FX_Item absent and FX_CustomerID present. Evidence: gate screenshots.

FX_Item created once through New with Type In Collection; Parameters IDO FX_Items, outputs %1 = FX_Description and %2 = FX_Cost, In Collection Only Property FX_Item, Error Message mIsNotAValid (or blank with the No answer recorded), each committed with Tab before OK; each dialog confirmed once. Evidence: dialog screenshots before each OK.

The readback shows Type In Collection and the Parameters value verbatim FX_Items( PROPERTY(FX_Item) SETP(%1=FX_Description,%2=FX_Cost) ) and Error Message mIsNotAValid (corrections, if any, within the contingency); FX_CustomerID still listed; exactly one Designer Save with its native response, or Save disabled recorded. Evidence: readback and Save screenshots.
The clean Form closed once and reopened once; the reopened readback matches AC-3; no component changed; no other validator changed. Evidence: reopen readback screenshots.

The final EXP-090 report gives decisive evidence for AC-1 to AC-4, the complete action audit with exact counts (validators created 1, New 1, Set Prop outputs 2, dialog OKs, Tab commits, string prompts and answers, contingency corrections, Designer Save at most 1, Designer close/reopen 1, zero component changes, zero runtime actions, zero checkout actions, re-login count), the worker-written-file inventory and the final state. Repository confinement is supported by worker/harness inventories, with operator git review authoritative. Findings are observed only.

initial_instruction: T1 - Read-only session gate and preflight for EXP-090. Review AGENTS.md, hello-world-pt5.md Sections 11-12 with their transcript lines, the EXP-087 record and outcome, the EXP-089 outcome and the EXP-079 record. Without shell/git access, record the starting state concisely. List the browser tabs before selecting one; identify the Web Client and Web Designer tabs and record whether each is live. If the Web Client shows a sign-out or sign-in page, follow the worker-preamble procedure (top-level portal navigation only) and end the task. Confirm the Designer is in User scope and clean with FX_Orders open (open it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry if needed). Open Designer Edit > Validator once; if it returns the server-event error, answer OK once, record it and stop for the coordinator. Otherwise record whether FX_Item exists and that FX_CustomerID is present, and close it with Cancel. Create the EXP-090 record with the baseline, the action audit and the worker-written-file inventory, with screenshots under evidence/EXP-090/. Stop before using New in the Validators list.
notes: Proposed by the operator assistant after EXP-089 and approved in outline by the operator on 2026-10-14 ("yes"). Repeats the accepted EXP-087 procedure for the Item side. Mapping: Items IDO -> FX_Items, Item -> FX_Item, Description -> FX_Description, Cost -> FX_Cost; the FX_Orders targets (FX_ItmsDescription, FX_ItmsCost) are passed later through the component class parameters. Adds a session gate: a Designer tab loaded before a session expiry returns a server-event error and needs an operator reload (EXP-089). No unload is authorized. exact_values: FX_Item, In Collection, FX_Items, FX_Description, FX_Cost, %1, %2, mIsNotAValid. deny_browser_javascript. Approved by the operator 2026-10-14 with precondition attestation: logged in, configuration OK, Web Client and Web Designer loaded, no unsaved changes.
